guide.title: Remove delays between two jumps in control.con
guide.body:
Under `ControlMap.create InfantryPlayerInputControlMap` 
find the line:
`ControlMap.addKeyToTriggerMapping c_PIAction IDFKeyboard IDKey_Space 10000 0` 
and change it to
`ControlMap.addKeyToTriggerMapping c_PIAction IDFKeyboard IDKey_Space 0 0`

Sometimes it is better to change this file after to read only (Be aware you will not be able to change controls in game menu without disabling read only)

With this change it is a lot easier to perform linked jumps.

guide.title: Fps lock and fps stability
guide.body:
Two commands in Bf2 console that will help to unlock full potential of your PC. Idealy you should see more than 100 FPS in upper left corner. Jumps will be easier and smoothier.

```
game.lockfps 0
renderer.drawfps 1
```

In case of high hz monitor it could be useful to lock fps to your hz
`game.lockfps 120`
or
`game.lockfps 144`
or 
`game.lockfps 360`
